business_summary: BlueMeme Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the DX business in Japan. The company offers OutSystems, a low-code development platform, including rich grid component, SVF cloud connector, Omnext, OutSystems training, and document generations services; MarkLogic, a multi-model database; Workato, an integration platform that automates various workflows that require collaboration between multiple applications with low code; Creatio, a no-code BPM platform for business applications that automates and visualizes business processes; and mabl, an AI-based test automation platform that enables low-code automatic testing of workflows, visuals, APIs, browser compatibility, and others. It also provides consulting services, including low-code implementation assessment services, business analysis and requirements definition services, remote technical support for business application development, and proposal for the development of AGILE-DX; contract development services, such as low-code contract development, source code migration services, and BlueMeme digital agent services; seminars and training of low code engineers; and sale and support of software products. The company was formerly known as BlueMeme Inc. and changed its name to BlueMeme Group Inc. in October 2026. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
